verdict.rationale: Shopify documents real outbound HTTP order webhooks to a registered endpoint. They are HMAC-SHA256 signed, carry full order state, and are retried up to 8 times over 4 hours. However, subscription is not self-serve: delivery URL and topic scoping are registered server-side by contacting a partner manager, and the UCP profile webhook_url field is not honored. Coverage is limited to order-change events. Missing for 10: a self-serve or programmatic subscription API, honoring the profile webhook_url, event topics beyond orders, and independent hands-on corroboration of delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Shopify pushes UCP-shaped order webhooks to your registered endpoint whenever an order placed through your agent has a committed change (fulfillment progress, refunds, returns, exchanges, order edits, or cancellations).
Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times over 4 hours with exponential backoff.
There's no self-serve subscription API today: your delivery URL and topic scoping are registered server-side. To set up or update an order webhook subscription, contact your Shopify partner manager.
Use webhooks as the primary update channel.
